title: Implementation: Enable up to N concurrent Claude workers across different tasks with per-worker CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolation
acceptance_criteria: harness/autowork_daemon.py dispatches up to claude_parallel_cap workers concurrently in parallel, falling back to sequential only when exceeding the cap.
harness/orchestrator.py builds a distinct per-task CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR env variable for headless Claude and seeds it idempotently.
The authored tests in tests/harness/test_claudecap_parallel_isolation.py pass green: python -m pytest tests/harness/test_claudecap_parallel_isolation.py -q

spec.objective: Implement the configurable workers.claude_parallel_cap parameter, modify the dispatch loop to support concurrent spawning of Claude workers in parallel up to the cap, and configure distinct per-task seeded config directory environment variables for headless Claude workers.
functional_requirements: Implement configurable `workers.claude_parallel_cap` in autowork config with a default of 4, clamped to `[1, parallel_cap]`.
Modify the `autowork_daemon` iteration loop to dispatch up to `claude_parallel_cap` concurrent Claude workers in parallel using `_spawn_worker` without blocking or suspending.
Ensure sequential fallback (suspension and blocking) is only triggered when in-flight Claude workers would exceed `claude_parallel_cap`.
In `orchestrator._build_agent_env`, for headless Claude backend, generate a distinct `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` based on task work directory and seed it idempotently with credential files.
Implement the environment changes and seeding in a fail-safe manner, falling back to HEAD behavior on any exception.
edge_cases: test_claude_parallel_cap_4_disjoint_tasks_run_concurrently: cap=4 with two disjoint-files claude tasks dispatch via the parallel branch (no mutual SIGSTOP).
test_headless_claude_env_gets_distinct_config_dir: each claude worker env gets a distinct per-task CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; gemini/agy env unchanged.
non_goals: An integration shim, an integration-level e2e harness, or a live-concurrency integration test is explicitly out of scope.
spec.implementation_notes: Write _claude_parallel_cap in autowork_daemon.py, update the dispatch loop condition in autowork_daemon.py, modify _build_agent_env in orchestrator.py, and add workers.claude_parallel_cap: 4 to config.yaml.

token_budget_ratio.note: Implementation of parallel cap and config dir isolation, verified by tests.
